name: textbook-finder
description:
中文：按内容或关键词查找正规来源的教材 PDF，核验下载、版次和年份，优先新版。
English: Find textbook PDFs by topic or keyword from reputable sources, verify downloads, editions and years, and prioritize recent editions.

interface.shortDescription: 正规教材 PDF，优先新版 | Official textbook PDFs, newest first
interface.longDescription:
中文
根据学习内容或关键词，独立检索出版社、高校、官方机构与开放教材平台。核验来源、完整 PDF 下载情况、版次和出版年份，区分完整教材、分章下载、试读与在线阅读；在符合需求的候选中优先新版，提供来源页及下载入口。用户要求时下载所选教材，不自动开课或创建课堂笔记。

English
Independently search publishers, universities, official institutions, and open textbook platforms using a topic or keywords. Verify provenance, full PDF availability, edition, and publication year. Distinguish complete textbooks from chapter downloads, samples, and online-only resources. Prioritize newer suitable editions and provide source pages and download links. Download selected materials when requested, without starting a course or creating lesson notes.
interface.defaultPrompt: 帮我根据想学习的内容查找正规来源、可下载的完整教材 PDF，按出版年份由新到旧优先选择。
